footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: after $2.3M of discontinued operations. No per-share figures were reported for these years.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 10.3% to $649M in 2025. Gross margin was 10.5%, versus 10.1% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $656K from $758K.
The net loss narrowed to $22.8M, or $0.00 per share, from $27.9M. Operating cash flow was $44.6M and free cash flow $34.0M, versus −$52.0M.
sources: Commercial Vehicle Group, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
